records.definition_zh: 頓咳(又稱頓嗆、百日咳)是感受時邪疫毒引起的一種以痙攣性咳嗽為特徵的急性肺系傳染病，以陣發性痙攣性咳嗽、咳末伴雞鳴樣吸氣性回聲、咳劇則嘔吐痰涎為特徵，病程遷延可達數週至數月，故又名「百日咳」。
records.definition_en: Dun Ke (Whooping Cough / Pertussis) is an acute respiratory infectious disease caused by contracting an epidemic pathogenic toxin, characterized by paroxysmal spasmodic coughing fits ending in a crowing inspiratory whoop, with vomiting of phlegm-saliva when the coughing is severe; the illness can drag on for weeks to months, hence its alternate name "the hundred-day cough."
records.etiology_zh: 感受時邪疫毒(時行邪毒)由口鼻而入，侵犯肺系；多發於冬春季節，經呼吸道飛沫傳染，好發於五歲以下嬰幼兒。
records.etiology_en: Contraction of an epidemic pathogenic toxin entering via the mouth and nose and invading the Lung system; it occurs mainly in winter and spring, spreads by respiratory droplet, and is most common in children under five.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 時邪疫毒自口鼻而入，蘊於肺胃，鬱而化熱，煉液成痰，痰熱阻遏氣道、肺失肅降，肺氣上逆而作痙咳。病程分初咳期(邪犯肺衛，證類感冒)、痙咳期(痰火阻肺，氣逆痰壅，出現特徵性陣發痙攣性咳嗽伴雞鳴樣回聲)、恢復期(肺脾兩虛，痰去咳緩)三期。若正氣虧虛、痰阻氣閉，可內陷心肝，發為驚厥、神昏等變證，或痰阻氣道釀成肺炎喘嗽、甚則氣脫之危候，尤多見於未滿周歲之嬰兒。
records.pathomechanism_en: The epidemic toxin enters via the mouth and nose and brews in the Lung and Stomach, stagnating and transforming into Heat that condenses fluids into Phlegm; Phlegm-Heat obstructs the airway and the Lung loses its descending function, so Lung Qi rebels upward as spasmodic coughing. The course has three stages: the initial-cough stage (pathogen invading the Lung-Wei level, resembling a common cold), the spasmodic-cough stage (Phlegm-fire obstructing the Lung with Qi rebellion and Phlegm congestion, producing the characteristic paroxysmal spasmodic cough with the crowing whoop), and the recovery stage (Lung-Spleen dual deficiency, with Phlegm resolving and cough easing). If the correct Qi is depleted and Phlegm obstructs and blocks Qi movement, the pathogen can sink inward to the Heart and Liver, producing convulsion or clouded consciousness, or Phlegm blocking the airway can precipitate Lung-obstructing pneumonia-cough or even critical Qi collapse — most often seen in infants under one year old.
key_manifestations_zh: 陣發性痙攣性咳嗽(連續頓咳不能自止)
咳末伴雞鳴樣吸氣性吼聲
咳劇伴嘔吐痰涎
咳時面赤唇紫
涕淚俱出
key_manifestations_en: Paroxysmal spasmodic coughing fits that cannot be self-stopped once started
A crowing inspiratory whoop at the end of a coughing fit
Vomiting of phlegm-saliva with severe coughing
A flushed face with bluish-purple lips during the fit
Streaming nasal discharge and tears during the fit
associated_manifestations_zh: 目睛紅赤或球結膜下出血
associated_manifestations_en: Red, injected eyes or subconjunctival hemorrhage
An ulcer under the tongue (frenulum ulcer)
records.disease_location_zh: 肺，痰盛者及脾，重症內陷心、肝。
records.disease_location_en: The Lung, extending to the Spleen when Phlegm is heavy; in severe cases the pathogen sinks inward to the Heart and Liver.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 初咳期以疏風宣肺為主，痙咳期以瀉肺清熱、化痰止咳為主，恢復期以健脾益肺、化痰培本為主。
records.treatment_principle_en: The initial-cough stage is treated primarily by dispersing Wind and diffusing the Lung; the spasmodic-cough stage is treated primarily by draining the Lung, clearing Heat, transforming Phlegm, and stopping cough; the recovery stage is treated primarily by fortifying the Spleen, benefiting the Lung, and transforming residual Phlegm while restoring the root.
red_flags_zh: 未滿6個月之嬰兒感染頓咳，可能不出現典型雞鳴樣回聲，而以陣發性呼吸暫停(apnea)、發紺為主要表現，此為致命性徵象，應立即送醫急救
痙咳發作時出現嘴唇或面色發紺、意識改變或呼吸暫停，應立即就醫，不可僅以鎮咳藥物或針灸處理
頓咳病程中出現持續高熱、呼吸急促、胸壁凹陷，應警惕續發百日咳肺炎，是嬰幼兒百日咳死亡的主要原因
咳嗽劇烈伴抽搐或意識障礙，應警惕百日咳腦病(pertussis encephalopathy)，須立即轉診神經科評估
red_flags_en: An infant under 6 months infected with pertussis may not show the classic whoop, presenting instead mainly with paroxysmal apnea and cyanosis — this is a life-threatening sign and warrants immediate emergency care
Cyanosis of the lips or face, altered consciousness, or apnea during a coughing paroxysm requires immediate medical care — do not manage with cough suppressants or acupuncture alone

Persistent high fever, rapid breathing, or chest-wall retractions during the course of whooping cough should raise concern for secondary pertussis pneumonia, the leading cause of death from pertussis in infants
Severe coughing with convulsion or altered consciousness should raise concern for pertussis encephalopathy and requires immediate referral to neurology

records.definition_zh: 痄腮(又稱大頭瘟、蛤蟆瘟)是感受風溫邪毒引起的急性傳染病，以耳下腮部漫腫疼痛、咀嚼不便為主要特徵，多見於冬春季節，好發於學齡兒童，患後可獲終身免疫。
records.definition_en: Zha Sai (Mumps) is an acute infectious disease caused by contracting a Wind-Warm pathogenic toxin, characterized by diffuse swelling and pain below the ear at the cheek/parotid region with difficulty chewing. It is most common in winter and spring, occurs mainly in school-age children, and confers lifelong immunity after infection.
records.etiology_zh: 感受風溫邪毒(痄腮時邪)由口鼻而入，蘊結少陽、陽明經脈；經飛沫傳染，好發於集體生活兒童。
records.etiology_en: Contraction of a Wind-Warm pathogenic toxin entering via the mouth and nose and binding in the Shao Yang and Yang Ming channels; it spreads by respiratory droplet and is common among children in group settings such as schools.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 風溫邪毒由口鼻而入，鬱結少陽、陽明經絡。足少陽膽經、足陽明胃經均循行耳下頰部，邪毒壅阻經絡、氣血運行不暢，故見腮部漫腫疼痛；邪毒與氣血相搏、鬱而化熱，故見發熱。若邪毒熾盛，可內傳厥陰肝經，下竄睾腹，男孩出現睾丸腫痛(合併睾丸炎)，或邪毒內陷心肝，出現高熱、頭痛、嘔吐、抽搐、神昏等變證，屬痄腮重症。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Wind-Warm toxin enters via the mouth and nose and stagnates in the Shao Yang and Yang Ming channels. Because the Foot Shao Yang Gallbladder channel and Foot Yang Ming Stomach channel both traverse the region below the ear and the cheek, the toxin obstructs the channels and impedes Qi-Blood flow there, producing diffuse swelling and pain of the parotid region; the struggle between the toxin and Qi-Blood generates Heat, producing fever. If the toxin is severe it can transmit inward to the Jue Yin Liver channel and descend to the testes/lower abdomen, causing testicular swelling and pain in boys (mumps orchitis), or sink inward to the Heart and Liver, producing complications such as high fever, headache, vomiting, convulsion, and clouded consciousness — the severe form of mumps.
key_manifestations_zh: 耳下腮部漫腫疼痛(以耳垂為中心)
腫脹邊緣不清
按之有彈性感
咀嚼或張口疼痛加劇
key_manifestations_en: Diffuse swelling and pain below the ear at the parotid region, centered on the earlobe
Poorly demarcated swelling margins
An elastic, springy feel on palpation
Pain worsening with chewing or opening the mouth
associated_manifestations_en: Overlying skin of the swelling normal or only slightly red
records.disease_location_zh: 少陽、陽明經脈，重症內傳厥陰肝經。
records.disease_location_en: The Shao Yang and Yang Ming channels; in severe cases the toxin transmits inward to the Jue Yin Liver channel.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以清熱解毒、軟堅散結為治療總則，輕證疏風清熱、重證清熱解毒兼軟堅消腫，變證兼清肝瀉火或清熱息風。
records.treatment_principle_en: The overall principle is to clear Heat, resolve toxin, soften hardness, and dissipate binding; the mild type is treated by dispersing Wind and clearing Heat, the severe type by clearing Heat, resolving toxin, and softening/reducing the swelling, and complications are treated additionally by clearing the Liver and draining Fire, or clearing Heat and extinguishing Wind.
red_flags_zh: 痄腮患者(尤其青春期後男性)出現單側或雙側睪丸腫痛，應立即轉診泌尿科評估，需排除流行性腮腺炎併發睪丸炎，雙側嚴重感染有導致不孕的風險
痄腮病程中出現劇烈頭痛、頸項強直、嗜睡、意識改變或抽搐，應立即轉診急診，需排除腮腺炎併發腦膜炎或腦炎
痄腮伴上腹劇痛、持續嘔吐，應警惕合併胰臟炎，須轉診檢查
痄腮病程中突發單側聽力下降或耳鳴，應及早轉診耳鼻喉科評估，腮腺炎相關感音神經性聽損多為不可逆
青春期後女性痄腮患者出現下腹疼痛，需考慮合併卵巢炎，應轉診評估
red_flags_en: A patient with mumps (especially a post-pubertal male) who develops unilateral or bilateral testicular swelling and pain should be referred immediately to urology to rule out mumps orchitis — severe bilateral involvement carries a risk of infertility

Severe headache, neck stiffness, drowsiness, altered consciousness, or convulsion during the course of mumps should be referred to emergency care immediately to rule out mumps meningitis or encephalitis
Mumps with severe upper abdominal pain and persistent vomiting should raise concern for concurrent pancreatitis and be referred for evaluation
Sudden unilateral hearing loss or tinnitus during the course of mumps should be referred early to ENT for evaluation, as mumps-associated sensorineural hearing loss is usually irreversible
A post-pubertal female with mumps who develops lower abdominal pain should be evaluated for concurrent oophoritis

records.definition_zh: 癰是發生於體表皮肉之間的急性化膿性瘡瘍,因熱毒壅聚、氣血凝滯而成,其特點是局部光軟無頭、紅腫熱痛、根盤局限、易腫易膿易潰易斂,病位淺而範圍較大,屬陽證。
records.definition_en: Yong (acute superficial abscess) is an acute suppurative sore of the skin and superficial flesh caused by blazing heat toxin with stagnation of qi and blood; it is characterized by a smooth, soft, headless swelling that is red, hot, swollen, and painful, with a well-demarcated base — readily swelling, suppurating, rupturing, and healing. The lesion is superficial but often broad, and it belongs to the Yang (excess-heat) category of sores.
records.etiology_zh: 多因外感風溫濕熱之邪,或因皮膚破損、蟲咬、瘡癬染毒,邪毒乘隙侵入肌膚;或因恣食膏粱厚味、辛辣炙煿,脾胃蘊熱,內外之邪相搏,壅聚肌膚而發。
records.etiology_en: Most often caused by external contraction of Wind-Warmth or Damp-Heat pathogens, or by toxin entering through broken skin, insect bites, or infected tinea; alternatively, immoderate intake of rich, greasy, spicy, or fried foods leads to Spleen-Stomach heat accumulation, which combines with the external pathogen and congests in the flesh to produce the sore.
key_manifestations_zh: 患部光軟無頭
紅腫熱痛,根盤局限
腫勢急驟,易於成膿
按之中軟應指(膿成)
潰後膿出黃稠,腫消痛減
病程較短,易斂易癒
key_manifestations_en: Smooth, soft swelling with no visible head
Redness, swelling, heat, and pain with a well-demarcated base
Rapid onset with prompt tendency to suppurate
A soft, fluctuant center on palpation once pus has formed
Thick yellow pus on rupture, with swelling and pain then subsiding
A relatively short course that heals readily
associated_manifestations_en: Mild fever with aversion to cold
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在皮肉之間,與心、脾、胃關係密切。
records.disease_location_en: The disease is located in the skin and superficial flesh, closely related to the Heart, Spleen, and Stomach.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 初起以清熱解毒、行氣活血消腫為主;膿成則切開排膿;潰後宜補益氣血、托毒生肌。
records.treatment_principle_en: In the initial stage, clear heat, resolve toxin, move qi, and invigorate blood to disperse the swelling; once pus has formed, incision and drainage are indicated; after rupture, supplement qi and blood and use toxin-expelling, flesh-generating methods.

records.pathomechanism_zh: 熱毒壅聚肌膚,阻滯氣血運行,營衛不和則局部紅腫熱痛;熱盛肉腐則成膿;膿成而潰,毒隨膿泄,氣血漸復則瘡口收斂。若熱毒熾盛,可內攻臟腑,或走散入血,而見寒戰高熱、神昏譫語之走黃重證。
records.pathomechanism_en: Blazing heat toxin congests in the flesh and obstructs the movement of qi and blood; disharmony of nutritive and defensive qi produces local redness, swelling, heat, and pain. As heat intensifies it putrefies the flesh into pus; once pus forms and the lesion ruptures, the toxin drains with the pus and qi and blood gradually recover, allowing the wound to close. If heat toxin is overwhelming it can attack the internal organs or spread into the blood, producing the severe "toxin flooding" (走黃) pattern with chills, high fever, and clouded consciousness.
red_flags_zh: 癰腫伴高熱寒戰、神昏或煩躁不安,應警惕熱毒內陷(走黃)導致敗血症,須立即轉診西醫急診,不可僅以外治法處理。
發生於顏面鼻旁、上唇危險三角區的癰腫,切忌擠壓、針刺排膿,以免熱毒隨面部靜脈逆流入顱,引發海綿竇栓塞等顱內感染重症。
紅腫範圍迅速擴大並出現條索狀紅線(淋巴管炎)或全身中毒症狀,提示蜂窩性組織炎或菌血症擴散,須儘速轉診接受抗生素治療。
糖尿病患者或免疫力低下者出現癰腫,感染易迅速擴散且不易局限,應提高警覺並儘早轉診評估全身性感染風險。
red_flags_en: An abscess with high fever, chills, clouded consciousness, or agitation should raise concern for internal sinking of heat toxin (走黃) leading to sepsis; refer immediately to emergency care rather than relying on external treatment alone.

An abscess in the danger triangle of the face (beside the nose and upper lip) must never be squeezed or lanced, to avoid heat toxin flowing retrograde through the facial veins into the cranium and causing cavernous sinus thrombosis or another intracranial infection.
Rapidly expanding redness and swelling with streaking (lymphangitis) or systemic toxicity suggests spreading cellulitis or bacteremia and requires prompt referral for antibiotic treatment.
In diabetic or immunocompromised patients, an abscess can spread rapidly and fail to localize; heightened vigilance and prompt referral to assess systemic infection risk are warranted.

records.etiology_zh: 有頭疽多因外感風溫濕熱之毒,或因情志內傷、消渴宿疾,臟腑蘊熱,加之外感邪毒,內外合邪,壅聚肌膚而發;無頭疽多因寒濕痰濁凝滯筋骨,或因先天不足、房勞過度,腎氣虧虛,氣血運行不暢,寒痰瘀血結聚於深部而成。
records.etiology_en: Headed ju is most often caused by external contraction of Wind-Warmth or Damp-Heat toxin, or by internal damage from emotions or an underlying Wasting-Thirst (diabetes) condition creating heat accumulation in the organs that combines with an external pathogen to congest in the flesh. Headless ju is most often caused by Cold-Damp and turbid phlegm congealing in the sinews and bones, or by constitutional insufficiency and excessive sexual strain depleting Kidney qi, so that impaired qi-blood movement allows cold phlegm and static blood to bind in the deeper tissues.
key_manifestations_zh: 有頭疽:患部粟粒狀膿頭多個,漸融合成蜂窩狀瘡面
有頭疽:根盤大、紅腫熱痛,易向深部及周圍擴散
無頭疽:漫腫無頭,皮色不變或晦暗
無頭疽:部位較深,質地堅硬,疼痛徹骨
病程遷延,潰後收口緩慢
可伴筋骨損傷或關節功能障礙
key_manifestations_en: Headed ju: multiple millet-like pustular heads on the surface that gradually merge into a honeycomb-like sore
Headed ju: a large base with redness, swelling, heat, and pain that readily spreads deep and peripherally
Headless ju: a diffuse swelling with no head, skin color unchanged or dusky
Headless ju: located deeper, firm in texture, with pain penetrating to the bone
A protracted course with slow wound closure after rupture
May be accompanied by sinew-bone damage or joint dysfunction
associated_manifestations_zh: 年老、消渴患者可伴神疲乏力
無頭疽日久可見低熱、盜汗等陰虛表現
associated_manifestations_en: Severe local pain with restricted movement
In elderly or Wasting-Thirst patients, accompanying fatigue and lack of strength
In protracted headless ju, low-grade fever and night sweats reflecting Yin deficiency may appear
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在皮肉深部及筋骨,與心、肝、脾、腎關係密切,消渴患者尤與腎、脾相關。
records.disease_location_en: The disease is located in the deep flesh and the sinews and bones, closely related to the Heart, Liver, Spleen, and Kidney — in Wasting-Thirst patients it is especially related to the Kidney and Spleen.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 有頭疽初起清熱解毒、行氣活血,成膿則切開排膿,潰後扶正托毒;無頭疽初起溫通散結、化痰祛瘀,日久宜補益氣血、溫陽通絡,均需視膿之成否及正氣強弱靈活配合外治。
records.treatment_principle_en: For headed ju, clear heat and resolve toxin with qi-moving, blood-invigorating methods in the early stage, incise and drain once pus has formed, and support the correct qi to expel toxin after rupture. For headless ju, warm and free the channels to disperse the mass and transform phlegm and stasis in the early stage, supplementing qi and blood with warming, channel-freeing methods as the course prolongs — both require external treatment matched flexibly to pus formation and the strength of the correct qi.

records.definition_zh: 疽是發生於皮肉深處或筋骨關節間的瘡瘍,分有頭疽與無頭疽兩類:有頭疽為患處微紅、粟粒樣膿頭簇生、易向深部及周圍擴散的陽證瘡瘍;無頭疽則漫腫無頭、皮色不變或晦暗、部位較深、多屬陰證,病勢纏綿、易損傷筋骨。
records.definition_en: Ju (deep-rooted abscess) is a sore located deep in the flesh or between the sinews and bones, comprising two categories: "headed ju" (有頭疽, carbuncle) — a Yang-type sore with clustered millet-like pustular heads on a mildly red base that tends to spread deeply and peripherally; and "headless ju" (無頭疽) — a diffuse, headless swelling with unchanged or dusky skin color, located deeper, usually a Yin-type sore with a protracted course that readily damages sinew and bone.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 有頭疽為熱毒熾盛,深竄筋骨,腐肉為膿,若正虛毒盛,膿毒不能透發外泄,可內陷臟腑而見走黃之變,老年、消渴患者尤易生變;無頭疽為寒痰瘀血凝結,陽氣不能溫化,故漫腫堅硬、皮色不變,日久化熱釀膿,潰後多見膿水清稀、瘡口難斂,甚則損骨傷筋。
records.pathomechanism_en: In headed ju, blazing heat toxin burrows deeply into the sinews and bones and putrefies the flesh into pus; if the correct qi is deficient while toxin is strong, the pus and toxin cannot be vented outward and may sink inward to the organs, producing the toxin-flooding (走黃) crisis — a risk especially high in the elderly and in those with underlying Wasting-Thirst disease. In headless ju, cold phlegm and static blood congeal and Yang qi cannot warm and transform them, producing a diffuse, hard swelling with unchanged skin color; over time this transforms into heat and forms pus, and after rupture the discharge is often thin and watery with a wound that heals poorly, sometimes damaging bone and sinew.
red_flags_zh: 有頭疽合併高熱寒戰、神昏譫語或血壓下降,提示熱毒內陷(走黃)引發敗血症/膿毒症,須立即轉診急診,不可延誤。
糖尿病患者發生有頭疽,感染易迅速擴散且難以局限,應積極控制血糖並儘早轉診外科評估清創手術。
疽腫深達骨關節、伴持續性骨痛或竇道久不癒合,應警惕骨髓炎或深部膿腫,須影像學檢查及骨科/外科會診。
發生於項背(對口疽、搭手)且範圍迅速擴大者,因鄰近脊髓、大血管,病勢兇險,應立即轉診處理。
red_flags_en: Headed ju accompanied by high fever with chills, delirium, or a drop in blood pressure suggests internal sinking of heat toxin (走黃) causing sepsis; refer immediately to emergency care without delay.
In diabetic patients, headed ju can spread rapidly and fail to localize; blood glucose should be actively controlled and prompt surgical referral for debridement obtained.

A deep ju reaching bone or joint, with persistent bone pain or a non-healing sinus tract, raises concern for osteomyelitis or a deep abscess and requires imaging plus orthopedic/surgical consultation.
A ju on the nape or upper back (对口疽/搭手) that expands rapidly is dangerous given its proximity to the spinal cord and major vessels, and should be referred immediately.

records.etiology_zh: 多因外感暑濕熱毒,蘊蒸肌膚;或因皮膚不潔、搔抓、痱子染毒;素體脾胃濕熱偏盛,或消渴、陰虛內熱之人,更易反覆染毒而成癤病。
records.etiology_en: Most often caused by external contraction of Summerheat-Damp-Heat toxin steaming in the skin, or by unclean skin, scratching, or infected prickly heat; those with an underlying constitution of Spleen-Stomach Damp-Heat excess, or with Wasting-Thirst disease or Yin-deficiency internal heat, are more prone to recurrent infection and furunculosis.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 暑濕熱毒蘊結肌膚,阻於毛竅,郁而化熱,腐肉成膿,因病位淺、根盤小,故易膿易潰、膿泄毒消而斂;若濕熱內蘊未清,或陰虛內熱、氣血虧虛,衛外不固,則此癒彼發,纏綿反覆,形成癤病。
records.pathomechanism_en: Summerheat-Damp-Heat toxin binds in the skin and obstructs the hair follicle; it stagnates and transforms into heat, putrefying the flesh into pus. Because the lesion is shallow with a small base, it readily suppurates and ruptures, healing once the toxin drains with the pus. If internal Damp-Heat is not cleared, or Yin-deficiency internal heat or qi-blood deficiency leaves the defensive exterior unconsolidated, new lesions arise as old ones heal, producing the protracted, recurrent pattern of furunculosis.
key_manifestations_zh: 局限於單一毛囊,色紅灼熱
腫勢局限,突起根淺,範圍不超過3公分
繼則中央變軟,潰破出膿即癒
病程短,一般7-10日左右痊癒
癤病:此癒彼起,反覆發作
key_manifestations_en: Confined to a single hair follicle, red and burning hot
A localized, shallow-rooted, raised swelling generally no larger than 3 cm
The center softens, and healing follows rupture with pus discharge
A short course, typically resolving within about 7–10 days
Furunculosis: new lesions arise as old ones heal, in a recurrent pattern
associated_manifestations_zh: 癤病患者可伴口渴、便秘等內熱表現
associated_manifestations_en: Furunculosis patients may show internal-heat signs such as thirst and constipation
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在皮膚淺表毛囊,與心、脾、肺相關;癤病反覆者多涉及脾胃、腎。
records.disease_location_en: The disease is located in the superficial hair follicles of the skin, related to the Heart, Spleen, and Lung; recurrent furunculosis more often involves the Spleen-Stomach and Kidney.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以清熱解毒、消腫止痛為主,暑濕偏盛者兼清暑化濕;癤病反覆發作者,當於緩解期健脾益氣或滋陰清熱以扶正固表,減少復發。
records.treatment_principle_en: The main principle is to clear heat, resolve toxin, and reduce swelling and pain, with added clearing of Summerheat-Damp where that predominates. For recurrent furunculosis, the correct qi should be supported and the exterior consolidated during remission by fortifying the Spleen and boosting qi, or nourishing Yin and clearing heat, to reduce recurrence.
red_flags_zh: 生長於顏面鼻旁、上唇危險三角區的癤,切忌擠壓、挑刺,以免熱毒隨面部靜脈逆流入顱,引發海綿竇栓塞等顱內感染重症。
癤反覆發作、久治不癒,或單一癤腫異常腫大、伴高熱,應篩檢是否有糖尿病或免疫功能低下等潛在疾病,並轉診評估。
紅腫範圍迅速擴大、出現條索狀紅線或全身畏寒發熱,提示蜂窩性組織炎或菌血症,須儘速轉診接受抗生素治療。
red_flags_en: A furuncle in the danger triangle of the face (beside the nose and upper lip) must never be squeezed or lanced, to avoid heat toxin flowing retrograde through the facial veins into the cranium and causing cavernous sinus thrombosis or another intracranial infection.

Recurrent furuncles that resist resolution, or a single furuncle that is unusually large with high fever, should prompt screening for an underlying condition such as diabetes or immunodeficiency, with referral for evaluation.
Rapidly expanding redness and swelling with streaking (lymphangitis) or systemic chills and fever suggests cellulitis or bacteremia and requires prompt referral for antibiotic treatment.

records.definition_zh: 癤是發生於皮膚淺表、局限於單一毛囊及其周圍組織的急性化膿性疾病,以色紅、灼熱、腫痛範圍較小、突起根淺、易膿易潰易斂為特點,好發於夏秋季節及頭面、頸項、臀部等易受摩擦或多汗部位;反覆發作、此起彼伏者稱為「癤病」。
records.definition_en: Jie (furuncle/boil) is an acute suppurative condition confined to a single hair follicle and its surrounding tissue in the superficial skin, characterized by a small area of redness, burning heat, and swelling, a shallow-rooted raised lesion that readily suppurates, ruptures, and heals. It favors summer and autumn and sites prone to friction or sweating such as the face, scalp, neck, and buttocks; recurrent crops of furuncles arising one after another are termed "furunculosis" (癤病).

records.etiology_zh: 多因血分蘊熱,外感火熱毒邪,由破損皮膚(如足癬、皮膚皸裂、外傷)侵入而發;下肢丹毒常與濕熱下注、下肢慢性水腫或反覆皮膚破損有關;頭面丹毒多因風熱上攻;新生兒丹毒則因胎毒未清、肌膚嬌嫩,邪毒易於流竄。
records.etiology_en: Most often caused by Heat accumulated in the Blood level combined with an externally contracted Fire-Heat toxin entering through broken skin (such as athlete's foot, skin fissures, or trauma). Lower-limb erysipelas is often linked to Damp-Heat pouring downward, chronic lower-limb edema, or recurrent skin breaks; facial erysipelas is most often due to Wind-Heat attacking upward; and neonatal erysipelas arises from unresolved fetal toxin acting on the infant's delicate skin, allowing the pathogen to spread readily.
key_manifestations_zh: 患部皮膚突然鮮紅一片,色如塗丹
邊界清楚,略高出皮面
灼熱腫脹,壓之褪色,放手復原
迅速向四周蔓延
常伴惡寒發熱等全身症狀
可反覆發作
key_manifestations_en: A sudden patch of bright red skin resembling applied cinnabar
Sharply demarcated borders, slightly raised above the surrounding skin
Burning heat and swelling that blanches on pressure and returns on release
Rapid spread to the surrounding area
Often accompanied by systemic symptoms such as aversion to cold and fever
May recur repeatedly
associated_manifestations_zh: 患處附近淋巴結腫大疼痛
下肢丹毒反覆者可見患肢腫脹粗大
新生兒丹毒可見拒乳、煩躁、高熱驚厥
associated_manifestations_en: High fever with vexing thirst and headache
In recurrent lower-limb erysipelas, chronic swelling and thickening of the limb
In neonatal erysipelas, refusal to feed, restlessness, high fever, and convulsions may occur
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在皮膚血分,頭面丹毒與肝、心相關,下肢丹毒與脾、肝相關,新生兒丹毒病勢深重,可內傳臟腑。
records.disease_location_en: The disease is located in the skin at the Blood level; facial erysipelas is related to the Liver and Heart, lower-limb erysipelas to the Spleen and Liver, and neonatal erysipelas is especially severe and can transmit inward to the organs.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以涼血清熱解毒為總則:頭面部佐以疏風,下肢佐以利濕,新生兒丹毒宜及早清熱涼血解毒並密切觀察;反覆發作者兼活血通絡以防象皮腫。
records.treatment_principle_en: The overall principle is to cool the Blood, clear heat, and resolve toxin — combined with dispersing Wind for the facial type and disinhibiting Dampness for the lower-limb type. Neonatal erysipelas requires early, aggressive cooling of the Blood and resolving of toxin with close monitoring; recurrent cases should also invigorate the Blood and free the collaterals to prevent elephantiasis-like swelling.

records.definition_zh: 丹毒是因血分有熱、外感火熱毒邪、蘊阻肌膚而發的急性感染性疾病,以患部皮膚突然鮮紅一片、色如塗丹、邊界清楚、灼熱腫脹、迅速蔓延為特徵,好發於下肢及顏面,發於下肢者稱「流火」,發於頭面者稱「抱頭火丹」,新生兒發病遊走全身者稱「赤游丹毒」,病情較急重。
records.definition_en: Dan Du (erysipelas) is an acute infectious condition arising from Heat in the Blood level combined with an externally contracted Fire-Heat toxin that binds in the skin, characterized by a sudden patch of bright red skin resembling applied cinnabar, with sharply demarcated borders, burning heat, swelling, and rapid spread. It favors the lower legs and the face — when on the leg it is called "flowing fire" (流火), on the head and face "head-hugging fire cinnabar" (抱頭火丹), and in a neonate that spreads rapidly over the whole body, "wandering red cinnabar toxin" (赤游丹毒), a particularly acute and severe presentation.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 火熱毒邪與血分伏熱相搏,燔灼肌膚,故患處色紅如丹、灼熱腫脹,熱毒鴟張則迅速蔓延;熱毒熾盛可內攻臟腑,或入營入血,而見高熱、神昏之逆證,新生兒尤易毒邪走竄、內陷臟腑而危及生命;反覆發作者可因脈絡瘀阻而致患肢腫脹、皮膚粗糙,形成「大腳風」(象皮腿)。
records.pathomechanism_en: Fire-Heat toxin combines with latent Heat in the Blood level and scorches the skin, producing the cinnabar-red color with burning heat and swelling; when the heat toxin is unchecked it spreads rapidly. Overwhelming heat toxin can attack the internal organs, or penetrate to the Nutritive and Blood levels, producing the adverse pattern of high fever and clouded consciousness — neonates are especially prone to rapid spread of the toxin sinking into the organs and endangering life. Recurrent episodes can obstruct the channels and collaterals with stasis, causing chronic limb swelling and roughened skin that develops into elephantiasis-like lymphedema (大腳風).
red_flags_zh: 丹毒合併高熱寒戰、脈搏加快、神識改變等全身中毒症狀,提示鏈球菌菌血症/敗血症風險,須立即轉診接受靜脈抗生素治療,不可僅以外治法處理。
新生兒出現丹毒且皮損遊走蔓延迅速(赤游丹毒),病情可於短時間內惡化危及生命,應視為兒科急症立即送醫。
顏面丹毒範圍逼近眼眶、伴眼瞼腫脹或視力改變,應警惕眶蜂窩性組織炎,須立即轉診眼科/急診。
下肢丹毒反覆發作、患肢持續腫脹變硬,提示可能已進展為慢性淋巴水腫,應轉診評估並加強長期皮膚照護以防再感染。
red_flags_en: Erysipelas accompanied by high fever with chills, tachycardia, or altered mental status suggests a risk of streptococcal bacteremia/sepsis; refer immediately for intravenous antibiotic treatment rather than relying on external treatment alone.

Neonatal erysipelas that spreads rapidly and migrates over the body (赤游丹毒) can deteriorate within a short time and become life-threatening; treat as a pediatric emergency requiring immediate transfer.
Facial erysipelas approaching the orbit with eyelid swelling or visual change raises concern for orbital cellulitis; refer immediately to ophthalmology or emergency care.

Recurrent lower-limb erysipelas with persistent, hardening limb swelling suggests possible progression to chronic lymphedema; refer for evaluation and reinforce long-term skin care to prevent reinfection.

records.etiology_zh: 多因乳汁鬱積、排出不暢(乳頭凹陷、哺乳姿勢不當、乳汁過多未及時排空);加之情志不遂,肝氣鬱結,或產後飲食肥甘厚膩,胃熱壅盛;復因乳頭破損,外邪乘隙侵入,內外相合而發。
records.etiology_en: Most often caused by stagnant, poorly draining milk (from an inverted nipple, improper nursing technique, or oversupply not promptly emptied), compounded by emotional frustration causing Liver qi stagnation, or a postpartum diet rich in greasy, sweet foods causing Stomach heat accumulation; a cracked nipple then allows an external pathogen to enter, combining with the internal disorder to produce the disease.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 肝主疏泄、司乳汁排泄,胃經循行乳房、主乳汁化生,肝鬱氣滯與胃熱壅盛相互影響,乳絡阻塞、乳汁鬱積,鬱久化熱,熱盛肉腐則成膿;若邪毒熾盛而正氣未虛,易成膿潰破;若失治或誤治,毒邪走散,可形成傳囊乳癰(多發膿腔)或乳漏,潰後正虛毒戀者收口遲緩。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Liver governs free coursing and the release of milk, while the Stomach channel traverses the breast and governs milk production; Liver qi stagnation and Stomach heat accumulation aggravate each other, obstructing the milk ducts and causing milk stasis, which stagnates and transforms into heat — as heat intensifies it putrefies the flesh into pus. When toxin is strong but the correct qi is not yet deficient, suppuration and rupture readily occur; if mistreated or neglected, the toxin can spread to form multiple interconnecting abscess cavities ("chuan-nang" breast abscess) or a persistent fistula, and in those with deficient correct qi and lingering toxin after rupture, the wound closes slowly.
key_manifestations_zh: 乳房局部紅腫熱痛,可捫及結塊
結塊逐漸增大變軟,按之應指(成膿)
患乳脹痛,哺乳時尤甚
伴惡寒發熱、全身不適
潰後膿出黃稠,腫消痛減
key_manifestations_en: Local breast redness, swelling, heat, and pain with a palpable lump
The lump gradually enlarges and softens, becoming fluctuant on palpation once pus has formed
Breast distension and pain, worse with nursing
Accompanied by aversion to cold, fever, and general malaise
Thick yellow pus on rupture, with swelling and pain then subsiding
associated_manifestations_zh: 患側腋下淋巴結腫大疼痛
乳汁排出不暢或夾雜膿血
情志抑鬱、胸脅脹悶等肝鬱表現
associated_manifestations_en: Tender, enlarged axillary lymph nodes on the affected side
Poor milk flow, sometimes mixed with pus or blood
Stomach-heat signs such as thirst and constipation
Liver-stagnation signs such as emotional depression and chest-rib distension
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在乳房,與肝、胃兩經關係最為密切。
records.disease_location_en: The disease is located in the breast, most closely related to the Liver and Stomach channels.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 初起以疏肝清胃、通乳消腫為主,並強調及時排空乳汁;成膿則切開排膿;潰後氣血兩虛、餘毒未清者宜補益氣血、託毒生肌。
records.treatment_principle_en: In the initial stage, course the Liver, clear Stomach heat, and free the milk ducts to disperse the swelling, with an emphasis on promptly emptying the breast; once pus has formed, incision and drainage are indicated; after rupture, with qi-blood deficiency and lingering toxin, supplement qi and blood and use toxin-expelling, flesh-generating methods.

records.definition_zh: 乳癰是發生於乳房的急性化膿性疾病,多見於哺乳期婦女,尤以初產婦產後3-4週最為多見,以乳房紅腫熱痛、結塊、伴惡寒發熱為特徵,分「外吹乳癰」(哺乳期)與「內吹乳癰」(妊娠期)兩類,若失治可成膿潰破。
records.definition_en: Ru Yong (acute mastitis) is an acute suppurative condition of the breast occurring most often in lactating women, especially primiparas in the third to fourth week postpartum, characterized by breast redness, swelling, heat, pain, and a palpable lump accompanied by aversion to cold and fever. It is classified into "outer-blown breast abscess" (外吹乳癰, occurring during lactation) and "inner-blown breast abscess" (內吹乳癰, occurring during pregnancy); if untreated it can progress to suppuration and rupture.
red_flags_zh: 乳癰伴高熱寒戰、腫塊迅速增大且波動感明顯,提示膿腫已形成,須及早切開引流,單靠內服藥物恐延誤病情。
紅腫範圍迅速擴大、出現條索狀紅線或全身中毒症狀(意識改變、心跳加快),提示蜂窩性組織炎或敗血症風險,須立即轉診。
非哺乳期或停止哺乳後仍反覆出現乳房紅腫熱痛之腫塊,或腫塊表面皮膚呈橘皮樣改變、乳頭凹陷、經標準治療未消退,應轉診排除發炎性乳癌等惡性病變,不可逕以乳癰論治。
乳房膿腫反覆破潰不癒或形成瘻管(傳囊乳癰),應轉診外科評估是否需手術處理。
red_flags_en: Mastitis with high fever and chills accompanied by a rapidly enlarging, clearly fluctuant mass suggests an abscess has already formed and requires prompt incision and drainage; relying on oral medication alone risks delaying necessary treatment.

Rapidly expanding redness and swelling with streaking (lymphangitis) or systemic toxicity (altered mental status, tachycardia) suggests cellulitis or a risk of sepsis, and requires immediate referral.

A red, swollen, painful breast mass that recurs outside of lactation or after breastfeeding has stopped, or one with peau d'orange skin change, nipple retraction, or that fails to resolve with standard treatment, should be referred to rule out inflammatory breast cancer or another malignancy — it should not be treated as simple mastitis by default.
A breast abscess that repeatedly ruptures without healing or forms a fistula (傳囊乳癰) should be referred to surgery for evaluation of operative management.

records.definition_zh: 腸癰是發生於腸道的急性化膿性疾病,以轉移性右下腹疼痛、固定壓痛、拒按,伴發熱、噁心嘔吐為特徵,多因腸道氣血凝滯、鬱久化熱、熱勝肉腐而成癰膿,相當於西醫學之急性闌尾炎、闌尾周圍膿腫等,病情可迅速惡化,屬外科常見急腹症之一。
records.definition_en: Chang Yong (intestinal abscess) is an acute suppurative disease of the intestine characterized by migratory right lower quadrant pain, fixed tenderness, and guarding, accompanied by fever, nausea, and vomiting. It arises from stagnation of intestinal qi and blood that stagnates and transforms into heat, with heat putrefying the flesh into an abscess; it corresponds to acute appendicitis and periappendiceal abscess in Western medicine, can deteriorate rapidly, and is one of the classic surgical acute abdomens.
records.etiology_zh: 多因飲食不節(暴飲暴食、恣食生冷油膩)、飽食後急劇奔走或跌僕損傷,致腸腑運化失司;或因寒溫不適、外邪內侵腸道;或因情志不暢,肝鬱氣滯,腸道氣機不通,以上諸因均可致腸道氣血凝滯,鬱而化熱成癰。
records.etiology_en: Most often caused by dietary irregularity (overeating, or immoderate intake of raw, cold, or greasy food), by vigorous running immediately after a full meal or by trauma, which impairs the transportive function of the intestines; or by an external pathogen invading the intestines during improper temperature exposure; or by emotional frustration and Liver qi stagnation obstructing intestinal qi movement — all of these can cause stagnation of intestinal qi and blood that stagnates and transforms into heat, forming an abscess.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 腸道氣血運行不暢,氣滯血瘀,阻於腸絡,此為瘀滯期;瘀久化熱,濕熱蘊結腸腑,則見腹痛加劇、發熱,此為濕熱期;熱勝肉腐,血敗肉腐成膿,則見腹痛拒按、局部包塊,此為熱毒期;若腸癰潰破,膿毒瀰散腹腔,可致腹膜炎、腸粘連,甚則毒邪內陷、正氣暴脫,危及生命,故歷代醫家均強調腸癰病勢傳變迅速,須密切觀察。
records.pathomechanism_en: Impaired movement of intestinal qi and blood leads to qi stagnation and blood stasis obstructing the intestinal collaterals — this is the "stasis stage." Prolonged stasis transforms into heat, with Damp-Heat binding in the intestines producing worsening abdominal pain and fever — the "damp-heat stage." As heat intensifies it putrefies the flesh and corrupts the blood into pus, producing pain that resists pressure and a palpable local mass — the "heat-toxin stage." If the abscess ruptures, pus and toxin can disperse through the abdominal cavity, causing peritonitis and intestinal adhesions, and in severe cases the toxin can sink inward with sudden collapse of the correct qi, endangering life — classical physicians therefore stressed that chang yong progresses rapidly and requires close observation.
key_manifestations_zh: 轉移性右下腹疼痛(先臍周或上腹,後轉移固定於右下腹)
右下腹固定壓痛、反跳痛、拒按
發熱,體溫可隨病情加重而升高
噁心嘔吐,納呆
右下腹可捫及包塊(釀膿期以後)
key_manifestations_en: Migratory right lower quadrant pain (initially periumbilical or epigastric, then localizing and fixing to the right lower quadrant)
Fixed tenderness, rebound tenderness, and guarding in the right lower quadrant
Fever, with temperature rising as the condition worsens
Nausea, vomiting, and poor appetite
A palpable right lower quadrant mass once suppuration is established
associated_manifestations_zh: 右腿屈曲拒伸(腰大肌刺激徵象)
病情加重時可見冷汗淋漓、脈微欲絕之虛脫徵象
associated_manifestations_en: A yellow, greasy tongue coating with a wiry-slippery or surging-rapid pulse
Abdominal distension with either constipation or loose stool
Flexion of the right hip with resistance to extension (a psoas-irritation sign)
In severe deterioration, cold sweating and a faint, almost imperceptible pulse signaling collapse
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在腸腑(相當於闌尾),與脾、胃、大腸關係密切。
records.disease_location_en: The disease is located in the intestines (corresponding to the appendix), closely related to the Spleen, Stomach, and Large Intestine.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以通腑瀉熱、行氣活血、清熱解毒為總則,依瘀滯、濕熱、熱毒三期分證論治;若見腹膜炎、腸穿孔徵象或中毒性休克前兆,須立即外科手術處理,中藥僅作輔助,不可以之替代或延誤手術時機。
records.treatment_principle_en: The overall principle is to free the bowel and drain heat, move qi and invigorate blood, and clear heat and resolve toxin — treated according to the stasis, damp-heat, and heat-toxin stages. If there are signs of peritonitis, perforation, or impending toxic shock, immediate surgical intervention is required; herbal medicine serves only as an adjunct and must never substitute for, or delay, timely surgery.
red_flags_zh: 腹部出現反跳痛、肌肉緊張如板狀腹,提示腹膜炎或闌尾穿孔,屬外科急症,須立即轉診急診手術,絕不可先行針灸或單純中藥治療而延誤。
疼痛突然減輕後又轉為瀰漫性全腹劇痛、發熱加劇,為闌尾穿孔後腹膜炎的典型表現,須立即送醫。
發熱伴腹膜刺激徵象(拒按、反跳痛)、心跳加快、血壓下降,提示敗血症或中毒性休克前兆,屬危及生命之外科急症,須立即急診處理。
孕婦、老年人或糖尿病患者疑似腸癰時,臨床表現常不典型(疼痛部位可能偏移、發熱不明顯),更應提高警覺、及早以影像學檢查排除闌尾炎,避免延誤手術時機。
腸癰確診或高度懷疑闌尾炎者,禁止腹部推拿、按壓包塊或灌腸,以免促使闌尾穿孔或膿腫破裂。
red_flags_en: Rebound tenderness with board-like abdominal rigidity suggests peritonitis or appendiceal perforation — a surgical emergency requiring immediate emergency referral for surgery; never attempt acupuncture or herbal treatment alone in place of, or as a delay to, surgical care.

Pain that suddenly lessens and is then followed by diffuse, severe abdominal pain and worsening fever is a classic presentation of peritonitis after appendiceal perforation and requires immediate transfer to emergency care.

Fever with peritoneal signs (guarding, rebound tenderness), tachycardia, and falling blood pressure suggests impending sepsis or toxic shock — a life-threatening surgical emergency requiring immediate emergency management.

In pregnant, elderly, or diabetic patients, suspected chang yong (appendicitis) often presents atypically (displaced pain location, blunted fever response); vigilance should be heightened and imaging obtained early to rule out appendicitis and avoid delaying surgery.
In confirmed or strongly suspected chang yong (appendicitis), abdominal massage, palpation of the mass, or enemas are contraindicated, as they risk precipitating perforation or abscess rupture.

Flags below are established TCM/biomedical clinical knowledge treated with full surgical-emergency seriousness per explicit task instruction, not curriculum or whitelist-verified — flag for Ting to source-check.

records.definition_zh: 脫疽是發生於四肢末端(以下肢多見)、因脈絡阻塞、氣血不能榮養肢端而致的慢性壞疽性疾病,以患趾(指)蒼白、發涼、麻木、間歇性疼痛,漸至紫黑腐爛、脫落為特徵,相當於西醫學之血栓閉塞性脈管炎(Buerger氏病)、閉塞性動脈硬化症等所致之肢體缺血壞疽,病程遷延、致殘率高。
records.definition_en: Tuo Ju (gangrenous sore) is a chronic gangrenous condition of the distal extremities (most often the lower limbs) caused by obstruction of the channels and collaterals that prevents qi and blood from nourishing the extremity, characterized by pallor, coldness, numbness, and intermittent claudication of the affected digit, progressing to purplish-black necrosis and eventual auto-amputation. It corresponds to the limb ischemia and gangrene of thromboangiitis obliterans (Buerger's disease) and arteriosclerosis obliterans in Western medicine, follows a protracted course, and carries a high rate of disability.
records.etiology_zh: 多因先天稟賦不足,脾腎陽虛,復因寒濕之邪外侵,或長期吸菸、嗜食肥甘,損傷脾胃、痰濕內生;情志不遂、肝鬱氣滯,或外傷、凍傷損及脈絡,均可致氣血運行不暢、瘀阻脈道而發病;久病或病重者陰血耗傷,虛熱內生,病情益加複雜。
records.etiology_en: Most often caused by constitutional insufficiency with Spleen-Kidney Yang deficiency, compounded by external invasion of Cold-Damp pathogens, or by long-term smoking and a diet rich in greasy, sweet foods that damage the Spleen and Stomach and generate internal phlegm-damp; emotional frustration with Liver qi stagnation, or trauma and frostbite damaging the channels and collaterals, can likewise impair the movement of qi and blood and cause stasis obstructing the vessels. In protracted or severe disease, Yin and Blood are further depleted and deficiency-heat arises internally, compounding the condition.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 陽氣不足,寒濕之邪乘虛侵襲肢端脈絡,寒性凝滯,氣血運行受阻,不能溫養肢端,故見蒼白發涼、麻木疼痛;病久寒鬱化熱,或濕熱毒邪內蘊,則患趾紫紅腫脹、疼痛加劇,終致熱勝肉腐、瘀血敗壞而成黑腐壞疽;若病久陰血耗傷,虛火內熾,瘡面久不癒合;晚期正氣衰敗、氣血兩虛,壞疽範圍擴大,甚則毒邪內陷危及生命。
records.pathomechanism_en: Deficient Yang qi allows Cold-Damp pathogens to invade the channels and collaterals of the extremity while the correct qi is weak; the congealing nature of Cold obstructs the movement of qi and blood so that the extremity cannot be warmed and nourished, producing pallor, coldness, numbness, and pain. As the disease persists, congealed Cold transforms into Heat, or Damp-Heat toxin accumulates internally, producing a purplish-red, swollen digit with intensifying pain, and eventually the overwhelming Heat putrefies the flesh and corrupts the static blood into black necrotic gangrene. With prolonged illness, Yin and Blood are depleted and deficiency-fire blazes internally so the wound fails to heal; in the late stage the correct qi collapses with severe qi-blood deficiency, the gangrene expands, and toxin may sink inward, endangering life.
key_manifestations_zh: 患肢趾(指)端蒼白或紫紺、發涼
患肢麻木、間歇性跛行
靜息痛,夜間尤甚
患肢動脈搏動減弱或消失
病進則紫黑腐爛,甚則干性或濕性壞疽、指(趾)節脫落
key_manifestations_en: Pallor or cyanosis and coldness of the affected digit(s)
Numbness of the affected limb and intermittent claudication
Rest pain, worse at night
Diminished or absent arterial pulses in the affected limb
As the disease progresses, purplish-black necrosis, and eventually dry or wet gangrene with auto-amputation of the digit
associated_manifestations_zh: 患肢皮膚乾燥、汗毛脫落、指甲增厚變形
濕性壞疽者可見局部滲液惡臭、發熱等感染徵象
病久可見面色萎黃、神疲乏力等氣血兩虛表現
associated_manifestations_en: Dry skin, loss of hair, and thickened, deformed nails on the affected limb
Muscle atrophy with thinning of the affected limb
In wet gangrene, malodorous local discharge and fever indicating infection
In protracted disease, sallow complexion and fatigue reflecting qi-blood deficiency
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在四肢末端脈絡,與脾、腎關係最為密切,亦與肝相關。
records.disease_location_en: The disease is located in the channels and collaterals of the distal extremities, most closely related to the Spleen and Kidney, and also related to the Liver.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 初起以溫陽散寒、活血通絡為主;化熱者清熱利濕、活血化瘀;壞疽已成者需視乾濕壞疽及全身情況,配合清熱解毒或補益氣血,並強調戒菸、避免患肢受寒受傷;若保守治療無效或缺血嚴重,須及早轉診血管外科評估手術(如血運重建、截肢)。
records.treatment_principle_en: In the initial stage, warm Yang, dispel Cold, and invigorate the Blood to free the collaterals; once Heat has formed, clear heat, disinhibit dampness, and resolve blood stasis. Once gangrene has developed, treatment is tailored to whether it is dry or wet and to the patient's overall condition, combined with clearing heat and resolving toxin or supplementing qi and blood, with strong emphasis on smoking cessation and protecting the limb from cold and injury. When conservative treatment fails or ischemia is severe, early referral to vascular surgery for evaluation (revascularization or amputation) is required.
red_flags_zh: 患肢突然出現劇烈疼痛、蒼白冰冷、脈搏消失、感覺喪失或運動障礙(5P徵象),提示急性動脈栓塞/血栓形成,屬肢體缺血急症,須立即送急診評估,爭取黃金搶救時間,延誤可致截肢。
壞疽組織出現紅腫熱痛擴大、膿性分泌物惡臭、發熱寒顫,提示濕性壞疽合併感染,有敗血症風險,須立即轉診接受抗生素治療及外科清創評估,不可僅以外治法處理。
靜息痛持續加劇、患肢動脈搏動消失合併組織壞死範圍擴大,提示嚴重肢體缺血(critical limb ischemia),須及早轉診血管外科評估血運重建,以避免截肢。
糖尿病患者出現脫疽相關症狀,因合併周邊神經病變常痛覺遲鈍、易低估病情嚴重度,應主動檢查足部並提高轉診警覺。
red_flags_en: Sudden severe pain, pallor, coldness, absent pulse, and loss of sensation or motor function in the limb (the 5 P's) suggest acute arterial embolism or thrombosis — a limb-threatening ischemic emergency requiring immediate emergency evaluation within the critical treatment window; delay can result in amputation.

Expanding redness, swelling, heat, and pain in gangrenous tissue with malodorous purulent discharge, fever, and chills suggests wet gangrene with superimposed infection and a risk of sepsis; refer immediately for antibiotic treatment and surgical debridement evaluation rather than relying on external treatment alone.

Progressively worsening rest pain with absent limb pulses and expanding tissue necrosis suggests critical limb ischemia; refer early to vascular surgery for evaluation of revascularization to avoid amputation.

In diabetic patients with tuo-ju-type symptoms, coexisting peripheral neuropathy often blunts pain perception and can lead to underestimating severity; proactive foot examination and heightened vigilance for referral are warranted.

Flags below are established TCM/biomedical clinical knowledge treated with full limb-threatening-emergency seriousness per explicit task instruction, not curriculum or whitelist-verified — flag for Ting to source-check.

records.definition_zh: 乳癖是以乳房出現單個或多個腫塊、脹痛或刺痛，且腫塊大小與脹痛程度隨月經週期或情志變化而消長為主要臨床表現的乳房常見病，好發於30-45歲育齡期婦女，相當於西醫學的乳腺增生病（纖維囊性乳腺病）。
records.definition_en: Ru Pi (Mammary Gland Hyperplasia) is a common breast disorder marked by one or more breast lumps with distending or stabbing pain whose size and severity wax and wane with the menstrual cycle or emotional state. It is most common in women of childbearing age (30-45), and corresponds to Western medicine's fibrocystic breast disease / mammary hyperplasia.
records.etiology_zh: 情志不遂，肝氣鬱結，疏泄失常；思慮傷脾，脾失健運，痰濕內生；沖任二脈失於調攝，肝腎精血不足，天癸不充。
records.etiology_en: Emotional frustration causing Liver Qi stagnation with impaired free-coursing; excessive rumination damaging the Spleen, so the Spleen loses its transport-transformation function and internal Phlegm-Damp forms; and dysregulation of the Chong and Ren vessels from Liver-Kidney essence-blood insufficiency, with inadequate Tian Gui.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 肝主疏泄，情志不暢則肝氣鬱結，氣機不暢，氣滯血瘀，日久結聚成塊；脾失健運則痰濕內生，痰氣互結，凝聚乳絡，亦成腫塊。沖任二脈與肝腎相繫，沖任失調則乳房氣血運行、消長失常，故腫塊、脹痛隨月經週期起伏；病久氣鬱、痰凝、血瘀互結纏綿，若失於調治，理論上有惡變可能，臨床須與乳岩鑑別。
records.pathomechanism_en: Since the Liver governs free-coursing, emotional constraint leads to Liver Qi stagnation; impaired Qi movement causes Qi stagnation and Blood stasis that gradually coalesces into a lump. Spleen dysfunction generates internal Phlegm-Damp, which binds with stagnant Qi and congeals in the breast network vessels, likewise forming a lump. Because the Chong and Ren vessels are tied to the Liver and Kidney, their dysregulation disturbs Qi-Blood flow in the breast, so the lump and pain wax and wane with the menstrual cycle. Protracted binding of Qi stagnation, Phlegm, and Blood stasis, if left untreated, carries a theoretical risk of malignant transformation, so this disease must be distinguished clinically from Ru Yan (breast cancer).
key_manifestations_zh: 單側或雙側乳房脹痛或刺痛，經前加重、經後緩解
乳房內單個或多個腫塊，質地韌，邊界欠清，可被推動
腫塊大小與脹痛程度隨月經週期或情緒波動而消長
病程遷延，反覆發作
乳頭一般無溢液，或偶見少量非血性溢液
key_manifestations_en: Unilateral or bilateral breast distending or stabbing pain, worse before menses and easing after
One or multiple breast lumps, resilient in texture, poorly demarcated, and mobile on palpation
Lump size and pain severity wax and wane with the menstrual cycle or emotional fluctuation
Protracted course with repeated recurrence
Nipple discharge is usually absent, or occasionally scant non-bloody discharge
associated_manifestations_zh: 月經先後不定期或經量異常
associated_manifestations_en: Depressed mood or irritability with a quick temper
Distension and oppression in the chest and hypochondria
Irregular menstrual timing or abnormal flow volume
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在乳房，與肝、脾、腎及沖任二脈相關。
records.disease_location_en: The disease location is the breast, and it relates to the Liver, Spleen, Kidney, and the Chong and Ren vessels.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以疏肝理氣、化痰散結為治療總則，兼顧調攝沖任；肝腎精血不足者佐以補益肝腎。
records.treatment_principle_en: The overall principle is to course the Liver, regulate Qi, transform Phlegm, and disperse binding, while also regulating the Chong and Ren vessels; those with underlying Liver-Kidney essence-blood insufficiency additionally require tonification of the Liver and Kidney.
red_flags_zh: 乳房腫塊質地堅硬如石、表面凹凸不平、固定不移，或伴皮膚橘皮樣改變、乳頭凹陷、血性溢液者，不可逕以乳癖論治，應立即轉診乳房外科安排影像學（乳房攝影/超音波）及切片檢查以排除乳岩（乳腺癌）
單側新發、與月經週期無關、持續增大且不隨情緒或週期消退的乳房腫塊，應轉診評估，不可僅按乳癖觀察等待
red_flags_en: A stone-hard breast lump with an irregular surface, fixed and immobile, or accompanied by peau d'orange skin change, nipple retraction, or bloody discharge must not be treated as simple Ru Pi — refer immediately to breast surgery for imaging (mammogram/ultrasound) and biopsy to rule out Ru Yan (breast cancer)

A new unilateral breast lump unrelated to the menstrual cycle that keeps enlarging and does not regress with emotional state or cycle phase should be referred for evaluation rather than simply observed as Ru Pi

records.definition_zh: 乳岩是發生於乳房部的惡性腫瘤，以乳房腫塊質地堅硬如石、表面凹凸不平、與周圍組織粘連固定，可伴乳頭凹陷、患處皮膚橘皮樣改變，晚期潰爛翻花為主要表現，相當於西醫學的乳腺癌，好發於40-60歲婦女。
records.definition_en: Ru Yan (TCM Breast Cancer) is a malignant tumor of the breast characterized by a stone-hard, irregularly surfaced lump that is fixed to surrounding tissue, often with nipple retraction and orange-peel (peau d'orange) skin changes, progressing in late stages to ulceration with everted, flower-like tissue. It corresponds to Western medicine's breast cancer and is most common in women aged 40-60.
records.etiology_zh: 情志內傷，肝氣鬱結日久化火；憂思傷脾，脾失健運，痰濕內生；沖任失調，肝腎虧虛，精血不充；亦與先天稟賦不足相關。
records.etiology_en: Internal emotional damage causing protracted Liver Qi stagnation that transforms into fire; anxious rumination injuring the Spleen so that internal Phlegm-Damp forms; dysregulation of the Chong and Ren vessels with Liver-Kidney depletion and insufficient essence-blood; and a constitutional predisposition also plays a role.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 肝鬱氣滯，氣滯血瘀，痰瘀互結，日久蘊而化毒，結聚乳絡形成堅硬腫塊；沖任失調則氣血運行受阻，加重瘀毒互結。病情發展，毒邪熾盛可循經流竄，內傳臟腑，或外潰翻花；病久耗傷氣血陰陽，正氣日衰，邪毒愈盛，形成正虛邪實之危候，此為乳岩區別於乳癖等良性乳房病之關鍵。
records.pathomechanism_en: Liver depression and Qi stagnation lead to Blood stasis; Phlegm and stasis bind together and, over time, brew into toxin that congeals in the breast network vessels as a stone-hard mass. Dysregulation of the Chong and Ren vessels obstructs Qi-Blood flow, aggravating the binding of stasis and toxin. As the disease progresses, intense toxin can spread along the channels to invade the internal organs, or erupt externally as ulceration with everted tissue. Prolonged illness depletes Qi, Blood, Yin, and Yang; as correct Qi declines the pathogenic toxin intensifies, producing a critical pattern of root vacuity with branch excess — the key distinction between Ru Yan and benign breast disorders such as Ru Pi.
key_manifestations_zh: 乳房腫塊質地堅硬如石，表面凹凸不平
腫塊邊界不清，與周圍組織粘連，推之不移
乳頭凹陷、回縮或偏斜
患側皮膚呈橘皮樣改變或酒窩徵
病久潰爛翻花，滲流血水，腐臭難聞
腋窩或鎖骨上可觸及腫大堅硬淋巴結
key_manifestations_en: Stone-hard breast lump with an irregular, uneven surface
Poorly demarcated lump adherent and fixed to surrounding tissue
Nipple retraction, inversion, or deviation
Peau d'orange (orange-peel) skin change or skin dimpling over the lesion
Late-stage ulceration with everted, flower-like tissue and foul-smelling bloody discharge
Palpable, hard, enlarged axillary or supraclavicular lymph nodes
associated_manifestations_zh: 早期腫塊多不痛或痛感不明顯
病久可見形體消瘦、神疲乏力
晚期可伴咳嗽、骨痛等轉移徵象
associated_manifestations_en: In early stages the lump is usually painless or only mildly tender
Protracted disease brings emaciation and marked fatigue
Advanced disease may present cough, bone pain, or other signs suggesting metastasis
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在乳房，與肝、脾、腎、沖任二脈密切相關，晚期病邪可循經流竄，涉及全身臟腑。
records.disease_location_en: The disease location is the breast, closely tied to the Liver, Spleen, Kidney, and the Chong and Ren vessels; in advanced disease the pathogen can spread along the channels to involve the internal organs system-wide.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 早期以疏肝理氣、化痰散結、活血解毒為主，須配合西醫手術、放化療等規範綜合治療；中期扶正祛邪並施；晚期以扶正培本、帶瘤生存、改善生活品質為主。中醫治療應作為西醫規範診治的輔助，絕不可以中藥替代手術、放化療等標準治療而延誤病情。
records.treatment_principle_en: In the early stage, treatment courses the Liver, regulates Qi, transforms Phlegm, disperses binding, and resolves Blood stasis and toxin, always alongside guideline-based Western surgery, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy. In the middle stage, supporting correct Qi and expelling pathogens are combined. In the advanced stage, the emphasis shifts to supporting the root, living with the tumor, and improving quality of life. Chinese medicine should function as an adjunct to standard Western oncologic care and must never be substituted for surgery, radiotherapy, or chemotherapy in a way that delays proper treatment.
red_flags_zh: 乳房腫塊質硬固定、表面凹凸不平，或伴皮膚橘皮樣改變、酒窩徵者，應立即轉診乳房外科安排影像學（乳房攝影/超音波）及切片檢查，不可先以乳癖或痰核論治延誤診斷
乳頭出現血性溢液，或近期新發乳頭凹陷、內陷者，應立即轉診評估，不可僅以乳癖處理觀察
觸及腋窩或鎖骨上淋巴結腫大、質硬、固定者，提示可能已有淋巴轉移，應立即轉診腫瘤專科
已確診乳岩（乳腺癌）患者，中醫治療須與西醫手術、放療、化療、標靶或內分泌治療同步配合進行，絕不可以中藥替代規範西醫治療而延誤病情或使患者放棄西醫治療
red_flags_en: A hard, fixed breast lump with an irregular surface, or accompanied by peau d'orange skin change or dimpling, should not be treated as Ru Pi or a phlegm nodule — refer immediately to breast surgery for imaging (mammogram/ultrasound) and biopsy
Bloody nipple discharge, or newly developed nipple retraction/inversion, warrants immediate referral for evaluation rather than management as simple Ru Pi
Palpable, hard, fixed, enlarged axillary or supraclavicular lymph nodes suggest possible lymph node metastasis and require immediate referral to oncology

In a confirmed Ru Yan (breast cancer) patient, Chinese medicine must be coordinated with, never substituted for, guideline-based Western surgery, radiotherapy, chemotherapy, targeted therapy, or endocrine therapy — herbal treatment alone must never delay care or cause the patient to abandon standard oncologic treatment

records.definition_zh: 破傷風是皮膚破損後感染破傷風桿菌，其外毒素侵犯神經系統，以牙關緊閉、面呈苦笑、頸項強直、角弓反張、全身肌肉陣發性痙攣抽搐為主要表現的一種發病急驟、變化迅速、死亡率高的危急重症，屬中醫外科特殊感染性疾病。
records.definition_en: Po Shang Feng (Tetanus) is an acute, rapidly progressive, high-mortality emergency caused by Clostridium tetani infection through a skin breach, whose exotoxin attacks the nervous system, producing lockjaw (trismus), a fixed grimacing "risus sardonicus" expression, nuchal rigidity, opisthotonus, and paroxysmal generalized muscle spasms. It is classified in TCM Surgery as a special infectious wound disease.
records.etiology_zh: 皮膚破損（外傷、燒燙傷、動物或蟲咬傷、竹木刺傷、產後臍帶處理不潔等）感受風毒之邪，風毒之邪由傷口侵入，內傳經絡；正氣虧虛、瘡口深而窄、久不癒合、被泥土異物污染者尤易發病。
records.etiology_en: A break in the skin (trauma, burns, animal or insect bites, puncture by bamboo or wood splinters, or unclean handling of the umbilical stump after birth) allows a Wind-toxin pathogen to invade and travel inward along the channels. Those with weakened correct Qi, a deep and narrow wound, a wound that fails to heal promptly, or contamination with soil or foreign matter are especially susceptible.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 風毒之邪由破損傷口侵入人體，內竄經絡，阻滯氣血運行，筋脈失於濡養而拘急痙攣。風毒熾盛，內傳臟腑，上擾清竅則牙關緊閉、苦笑面容；風毒流竄周身經絡則頸項強直、角弓反張、四肢陣發性抽搐，輕微聲光觸碰即可誘發。病情進一步發展，風毒閉阻氣機，可致呼吸肌痙攣、窒息，甚則耗傷氣陰，內閉外脫而危及生命，屬中醫外科急危重症，全程需中西醫結合搶救。
records.pathomechanism_en: The Wind-toxin pathogen enters through the broken skin and travels inward along the channels, obstructing Qi-Blood flow; the sinews and vessels, deprived of nourishment, become tense and go into spasm. As the Wind-toxin intensifies and invades the internal organs, disturbance of the clear orifices produces trismus and the grimacing risus sardonicus; as it courses through the channels of the whole body it produces nuchal rigidity, opisthotonus, and paroxysmal limb convulsions that even minor sound, light, or touch can trigger. As the disease advances, Wind-toxin blocking Qi movement can cause spasm of the respiratory muscles and asphyxiation, and may ultimately deplete Qi and Yin, producing internal blockage with external desertion that threatens life — a critical emergency in TCM Surgery requiring integrated Chinese-Western emergency management throughout.
key_manifestations_zh: 潛伏期後首見全身乏力、頭痛、咀嚼肌緊張酸脹（張口困難）
牙關緊閉，苦笑面容
頸項強直，角弓反張
陣發性全身肌肉強直性痙攣，輕微聲光觸碰即可誘發
痙攣發作間歇神志始終清楚，發作時劇痛難忍
有明確皮膚破損外傷史
key_manifestations_en: After an incubation period, initial generalized malaise, headache, and tension/aching of the masseter muscles causing difficulty opening the mouth
Trismus (lockjaw) with a grimacing risus sardonicus expression
Nuchal rigidity and opisthotonus
Paroxysmal generalized tonic muscle spasms, triggerable by minor sound, light, or touch stimuli
Consciousness remains clear throughout, with severe unbearable pain during spasm episodes
A clear history of a preceding skin-breaking injury
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在經絡、筋脈，源於外傷傷口，病情深重時內傳臟腑，尤以肺（呼吸）受累最為危急。
records.disease_location_en: The disease location is the channels and sinews, originating at the wound; in severe disease it invades the internal organs, with Lung (respiratory) involvement being the most life-threatening.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以祛風解毒、鎮痙息風為主要治法；須緊急清創排毒，並立即配合西醫破傷風抗毒素/免疫球蛋白注射及重症監護支持治療，中醫治療僅作輔助，絕不可以中藥或針灸替代急救處置。
records.treatment_principle_en: The main treatment principle is to dispel Wind, resolve toxin, and settle spasm to extinguish Wind. Urgent wound debridement and toxin drainage are required, together with immediate Western tetanus antitoxin/immunoglobulin administration and intensive supportive care; Chinese medicine serves only as an adjunct and must never replace emergency medical management.
red_flags_zh: 有污染傷口史（尤其深而窄的刺傷、動物咬傷、燒燙傷、產後臍帶處理不潔）並出現張口困難、咀嚼肌緊張者，應立即轉診急診，不可先行針灸或內服中藥觀察——需儘早注射破傷風抗毒素/免疫球蛋白並清創
出現牙關緊閉、苦笑面容、頸項強直或角弓反張者，屬破傷風典型危重表現，為醫療急症，應立即送醫急救，不可在門診嘗試中藥或針灸治療
出現陣發性全身肌肉痙攣合併呼吸急促、發紺或吞嚥困難者，提示呼吸肌受累，隨時可能發生窒息，須立即啟動緊急醫療救援（撥打119/送急診）
外傷患者未完成破傷風疫苗全程接種或已超過建議追加接種時效者，即使當下症狀輕微，仍應轉診評估是否需接種疫苗及/或注射免疫球蛋白預防
red_flags_en: A patient with a contaminated wound history (especially a deep, narrow puncture wound, animal bite, burn, or unclean umbilical stump care) who develops jaw stiffness or masseter tension must be referred to the emergency department immediately — do not attempt acupuncture or oral herbal treatment first; prompt tetanus antitoxin/immunoglobulin and wound debridement are required

Trismus, risus sardonicus, nuchal rigidity, or opisthotonus are classic critical tetanus signs and constitute a medical emergency — send to emergency care immediately; do not attempt herbal medicine or acupuncture in an outpatient setting

Paroxysmal generalized muscle spasms accompanied by rapid breathing, cyanosis, or difficulty swallowing indicate respiratory muscle involvement with imminent risk of asphyxiation — activate emergency medical services immediately
A trauma patient with incomplete tetanus vaccination or one overdue for a booster should be referred for evaluation of vaccine and/or immunoglobulin prophylaxis, even if current symptoms are mild

records.definition_zh: 瘰癧是發生於頸部、耳後或腋下等處，以皮下多個大小不等、累累如串珠狀的結塊為主要表現的慢性感染性疾病，好發於體質虛弱的兒童及青壯年，相當於西醫學的頸部淋巴結結核。
records.definition_en: Luo Li (Scrofula) is a chronic infectious disease presenting as multiple, unevenly sized, string-of-pearls subcutaneous nodules in the neck, behind the ears, or in the axilla. It is most common in children and young adults with a weak constitution, and corresponds to Western medicine's cervical tuberculous lymphadenitis.
records.etiology_zh: 肺腎陰虛，虛火內灼，煉液成痰；情志不暢，肝氣鬱結，脾失健運，痰濕內生；痰濁循少陽、陽明經絡流注於頸項、耳後、腋下等處。
records.etiology_en: Lung-Kidney Yin deficiency with internal scorching by vacuity fire that boils the fluids into Phlegm; emotional constraint causing Liver Qi stagnation with concurrent Spleen dysfunction generating internal Phlegm-Damp; and the resulting turbid Phlegm flowing along the Shaoyang and Yangming channels to pool in the neck, behind the ears, and in the axilla.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 肝氣鬱結，疏泄失常，氣鬱化火，煉液成痰；或肺腎陰虛，虛火上炎，灼津為痰。痰濁循少陽、陽明經絡流竄，結於頸項、耳後、腋下，聚而成核，初起如豆，推之能移；日久痰鬱化熱，熱勝肉腐則成膿，膿液蝕潰皮肉，潰後膿水清稀，夾有敗絮狀物，瘡口凹陷，經久難斂，甚則此愈彼潰，形成竇道或瘻管；病久耗傷氣血陰液，可見形體消瘦、潮熱盜汗等陰虛勞損之象。
records.pathomechanism_en: Liver Qi stagnation with impaired free-coursing leads to depressive fire that boils the fluids into Phlegm; alternatively, Lung-Kidney Yin deficiency lets vacuity fire flare upward and scorch fluid into Phlegm. The resulting turbid Phlegm travels along the Shaoyang and Yangming channels and binds in the neck, behind the ears, and in the axilla, coalescing into nodules — initially bean-sized and mobile on palpation. Over time depressed Phlegm transforms into Heat, and Heat overwhelming the flesh causes suppuration; after rupture the discharge is thin, watery pus mixed with cotton-wadding-like debris, leaving a sunken wound that heals slowly, sometimes with new ruptures occurring as old ones heal, forming sinus tracts or fistulas. Protracted illness depletes Qi, Blood, and Yin, producing low-grade tidal fever and night sweats characteristic of Yin-deficiency consumptive taxation.
key_manifestations_zh: 頸部、耳後或腋下皮下腫塊，大小不等，累累如串珠
初起腫塊質硬，皮色不變，推之可移，不痛或微痛
日久腫塊融合成片，與皮膚粘連，漸轉暗紅，按之應指（已化膿）
潰後膿水清稀，夾有敗絮狀物質
瘡口凹陷，經久不斂，此愈彼潰，可形成竇道
病程遷延，反覆發作
key_manifestations_en: Subcutaneous lumps in the neck, behind the ears, or axilla, of uneven size, resembling a string of pearls
Initially firm, normal-colored, mobile nodules that are painless or only mildly tender
Over time the nodules coalesce, adhere to the overlying skin, turn dusky red, and become fluctuant (indicating suppuration)
After rupture, thin watery discharge mixed with cotton-wadding-like debris
A sunken wound that fails to close for a long time, with new ruptures forming as old ones heal, sometimes leaving sinus tracts
A protracted course with repeated recurrence
associated_manifestations_zh: 咳嗽，痰中帶血（肺陰虛甚者）
associated_manifestations_en: Cough with blood-streaked sputum (in cases with severe Lung Yin deficiency)
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在頸項、耳後、腋下皮部及少陽、陽明經絡，與肺、肝、腎相關，尤以肺腎陰虛為病本。
records.disease_location_en: The disease location is the skin of the neck, behind the ears, and axilla along the Shaoyang and Yangming channels, relating to the Lung, Liver, and Kidney, with Lung-Kidney Yin deficiency as the underlying root.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 初起以疏肝解鬱、化痰散結為主；成膿期宜托毒排膿；潰後以補益氣血、滋陰降火、生肌斂瘡為主，標本兼顧。
records.treatment_principle_en: In the early stage, treatment courses the Liver, relieves depression, transforms Phlegm, and disperses binding; once suppuration occurs, toxin is expelled and pus drained; after rupture, treatment focuses on tonifying Qi and Blood, nourishing Yin, downbearing vacuity fire, and promoting granulation and wound closure, addressing both root and branch.
red_flags_zh: 頸部腫塊質硬、固定、迅速增大，或伴不明原因發熱、夜間盜汗、體重明顯下降者，應轉診排除惡性淋巴瘤或其他惡性腫瘤，不可逕以瘰癧論治
確診或懷疑頸部淋巴結結核者，應轉診安排相關檢查（如胸部X光、結核菌素試驗、淋巴結切片培養）並配合西醫規範抗結核治療，不可僅以中藥托毒生肌延誤感染控制及傳染防治
瘡口潰爛經久不癒合、竇道反覆流膿並合併發熱者，應轉診評估是否合併其他細菌感染或病情擴散
red_flags_en: A firm, fixed, rapidly enlarging neck mass, or one accompanied by unexplained fever, night sweats, or marked weight loss, should be referred to rule out lymphoma or another malignancy rather than treated outright as Luo Li

A confirmed or suspected case of cervical tuberculous lymphadenitis should be referred for appropriate workup (chest X-ray, tuberculin skin test, lymph node biopsy/culture) and guideline-based Western anti-tuberculosis therapy — herbal toxin-expelling and granulation-promoting treatment alone is not sufficient to control the infection or prevent transmission

A wound that fails to heal for a long time, with a sinus tract that repeatedly discharges pus and is accompanied by fever, should be referred to evaluate for additional bacterial infection or disease spread

records.definition_zh: 疥瘡是由疥蟲寄生於皮膚角質層所引起的接觸傳染性皮膚病，以皮膚劇烈瘙癢（夜間尤甚）、指縫及皮膚皺褶處出現丘疹、水皰、隧道為主要表現，相當於西醫學的疥瘡（scabies）。
records.definition_en: Jie Chuang (Scabies) is a contagious skin disease caused by the Sarcoptes scabiei mite burrowing into the stratum corneum, characterized by intense pruritus (worse at night) and papules, vesicles, and burrows located between the fingers and in skin folds. It corresponds directly to Western medicine's scabies.
records.etiology_zh: 由疥蟲直接接觸傳染，或間接接觸患者衣物、被褥而感染；內因與濕熱蘊於肌膚、病久血虛生風化燥有關。
records.etiology_en: Direct skin contact with an infested person, or indirect contact with a patient's clothing or bedding, transmits the mite. The internal predisposing factor relates to Damp-Heat accumulating in the skin, and in chronic cases, Blood deficiency generating Wind and Dryness.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 疥蟲侵入皮膚角質層鑽鑿隧道，蟲毒引動內生濕熱，濕熱蘊蒸肌膚，發為丘疹、水皰。蟲毒滋生，搔抓不休，皮膚破損染毒化熱，可繼發膿皰瘡；病久濕熱耗傷陰血，血虛生風化燥，則皮膚粗糙肥厚、瘙癢纏綿難癒。
records.pathomechanism_en: The mite burrows into the stratum corneum, and its toxin stirs internal Damp-Heat, which steams the skin and produces papules and vesicles. As the mite population grows and scratching continues, the broken skin becomes infected and transforms into Heat, potentially leading to secondary impetigo. Over a prolonged course, Damp-Heat consumes Yin-Blood, and Blood deficiency generates Wind and Dryness, producing rough, thickened skin with intractable, protracted itching.
key_manifestations_zh: 皮膚劇烈瘙癢，尤以夜間為甚
好發於指縫、腕屈側、肘窩、腋窩、臍周、下腹、股內側及外生殖器等皮膚薄嫩皺褶處
皮損為米粒大丘疹、丘皰疹，或可見灰白色細線狀隧道
具傳染性，家庭或群體聚集發病
搔抓後可繼發抓痕、血痂，重複感染可見膿皰
key_manifestations_en: Intense pruritus, markedly worse at night
Predilection for the finger webs, flexor wrist, elbow crease, axilla, periumbilical area, lower abdomen, inner thighs, and external genitalia — sites of thin, folded skin
Millet-sized papules or papulovesicles, sometimes with visible grayish-white thread-like burrows
Contagious, often affecting family members or groups in close contact
Excoriations and blood crusts from scratching, with pustules appearing where secondary infection occurs
associated_manifestations_zh: 陰囊或外生殖器可見疥瘡結節，頑固難消
繼發感染時局部紅腫熱痛
皮膚粗糙肥厚（慢性反覆搔抓所致）
associated_manifestations_en: Persistent, stubborn scabetic nodules on the scrotum or external genitalia
Localized redness, swelling, heat, and pain when secondary infection occurs
Rough, thickened skin from chronic repeated scratching
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在皮膚肌腠，與濕熱蘊膚、病久血虛生風相關。
records.disease_location_en: The disease location is the skin and interstitial tissue, related to accumulated Damp-Heat and, in chronic cases, Blood deficiency generating Wind.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以外治殺蟲止癢為主，內服則清熱利濕、養血潤燥；並須切斷傳染途徑（衣物被褥煮沸消毒、患者適當隔離、同住接觸者同治）。
records.treatment_principle_en: The primary treatment is topical acaricidal therapy to kill the mite and relieve itching; internal treatment clears Heat, drains Dampness, and in chronic cases nourishes Blood and moistens Dryness. Interrupting transmission is essential — boiling or otherwise disinfecting clothing and bedding, appropriate isolation of the patient, and simultaneous treatment of household contacts.
red_flags_zh: 皮膚出現大片厚痂、廣泛脫屑覆蓋全身，並有免疫力低下病史（如愛滋病、長期使用免疫抑制劑或化療中）者，可能為結痂性（挪威）疥瘡，傳染力極強，應立即轉診並嚴格隔離，不可以一般疥瘡處理
搔抓處出現紅腫、灼熱、疼痛、化膿並伴發熱等蜂窩性組織炎徵象者，應轉診西醫抗生素治療，不可僅以外用中藥處理
red_flags_en: Widespread thick crusting and extensive scaling covering the body, especially in a patient with an immunocompromising condition (e.g. HIV/AIDS, long-term immunosuppressant use, or chemotherapy), may indicate crusted (Norwegian) scabies, which is extremely contagious — refer immediately and isolate strictly rather than treating as ordinary scabies
Redness, heat, pain, pus, and fever at excoriated sites suggest cellulitis and should be referred for Western antibiotic treatment rather than managed with topical herbal medicine alone

records.definition_zh: 疣是由病毒感染引起的皮膚贅生物，以皮膚出現堅硬粗糙的丘疹或贅生物為主要表現，依發病部位及形態不同可分為尋常疣、扁平疣、蹠疣等，相當於西醫學的病毒性疣。
records.definition_en: You (Wart) is a virally caused cutaneous growth marked by firm, rough papules or excrescences on the skin. Depending on site and morphology, it is subdivided into common warts, flat warts, and plantar warts, corresponding to Western medicine's viral warts.
records.etiology_zh: 肌膚腠理不密，復感風熱毒邪，或跌僕損傷後毒邪乘隙侵入肌膚；情志不遂，肝失疏泄，氣血失和，亦可誘發或加重病情。
records.etiology_en: A loosely consolidated skin interstice allows Wind-Heat toxin to invade, or toxin enters through a break in the skin following trauma; emotional frustration causing Liver dysfunction with disharmony of Qi and Blood can also trigger or aggravate the condition.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 風熱毒邪蘊結肌膚，氣血凝滯，搏結不散，發為贅生之疣；肝失疏泄，氣機不暢，氣血失和，使疣體纏綿難消或反覆發作，日久毒邪與氣血搏結，疣體漸大變硬。
records.pathomechanism_en: Wind-Heat toxin accumulates in the skin, causing Qi and Blood to congeal and bind together without dispersing, producing the wart growth. Liver dysfunction with impaired Qi movement and disharmony of Qi-Blood causes the wart to persist or recur repeatedly; over time the toxin binds ever more tightly with Qi and Blood, and the wart gradually enlarges and hardens.
key_manifestations_zh: 皮膚出現單個或多個灰白色或褐色堅硬丘疹、贅生物，表面粗糙
好發於手背、手指、面部、足底等暴露或摩擦部位
一般無自覺症狀，蹠疣受壓迫時可有疼痛
病程慢性，可自行消退亦可反覆增多、傳染擴散
具有一定傳染性（接觸傳播、自體接種）
key_manifestations_en: One or multiple firm, rough-surfaced grayish-white or brownish papules or growths
Predilection for exposed or friction-prone sites such as the dorsum of the hand, fingers, face, and soles
Usually asymptomatic, though plantar warts may be painful under pressure
A chronic course that may resolve spontaneously or recur and spread through autoinoculation
Contagious to some degree, via direct contact or self-inoculation
associated_manifestations_zh: 疣體周圍偶見小衛星狀新發皮損
蹠疣受壓時可影響行走
搔抓後可能自體接種擴散至他處
associated_manifestations_en: Small satellite lesions occasionally appear around the primary wart
Plantar warts can interfere with walking when under pressure
Scratching may spread the lesion to other sites via autoinoculation
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在皮膚肌腠，與肝失疏泄、氣血失和相關。
records.disease_location_en: The disease location is the skin and interstitial tissue, related to Liver dysfunction and disharmony of Qi and Blood.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以清熱解毒、活血散結為主，佐以疏肝理氣；外治可配合腐蝕、灼烙等法直接去除疣體。
records.treatment_principle_en: The main treatment principle is to clear Heat, resolve toxin, invigorate Blood, and disperse binding, together with coursing the Liver and regulating Qi; topical treatment may use caustic or cauterization methods to remove the wart directly.
red_flags_zh: 生殖器部位出現疣狀贅生物，應懷疑尖銳濕疣（菜花狀疣，一種性傳染病），需轉診檢查並排查其他性傳染病，不可僅以一般疣治療
病灶短期內迅速增大、出血、潰瘍或邊緣不規則，尤其發生於老年人或長期日曬部位者，應轉診皮膚科排除皮膚惡性腫瘤（如鱗狀細胞癌），不可逕以疣論治
red_flags_en: A wart-like growth on the genitals should raise suspicion for condyloma acuminatum (genital warts, a sexually transmitted infection) and warrants referral for testing and screening for other STIs rather than treatment as an ordinary wart

A lesion that rapidly enlarges, bleeds, ulcerates, or has an irregular border over a short period — especially in an elderly patient or at a chronically sun-exposed site — should be referred to dermatology to rule out a cutaneous malignancy (e.g. squamous cell carcinoma) rather than treated outright as a wart

records.definition_zh: 熱瘡是由熱毒蘊結肌膚引起的急性皰疹性皮膚病，以皮膚黏膜交界處（口唇、鼻孔、外陰等）出現成簇粟粒大小水皰、灼熱瘙癢為主要表現，好發於熱病之後或勞累、月經前後，相當於西醫學的單純皰疹。
records.definition_en: Re Chuang (TCM Herpes Simplex) is an acute vesicular skin disease caused by Heat-toxin accumulating in the skin, presenting as clustered millet-sized vesicles with burning and itching at mucocutaneous junctions (lips, nostrils, genitalia). It commonly follows a febrile illness or occurs with overexertion or around menstruation, and corresponds to Western medicine's herpes simplex.
records.etiology_zh: 外感風熱毒邪，蘊阻肌膚；或素體陰虛內熱，復感外邪引動伏熱；熱病後期餘熱未清，或勞倦過度、情志不暢而誘發。
records.etiology_en: External contraction of Wind-Heat toxin that accumulates and obstructs the skin; or, in those with constitutional Yin deficiency and internal Heat, an external pathogen stirring latent Heat; residual unresolved Heat after a febrile illness, or overexertion and emotional constraint, can likewise trigger onset.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 風熱毒邪外襲，蘊結肺胃，循經上蒸，發於口唇鼻周皮膚黏膜交界處，發為水皰；若素體陰虛內熱，虛火與外邪相搏，亦可誘發。病邪反覆蘊伏於肌膚經絡，遇勞累、情志不暢、熱病、月經來潮等誘因而反覆發作，纏綿不已；水皰潰破染毒，可繼發糜爛滲液。
records.pathomechanism_en: External Wind-Heat toxin accumulates in the Lung and Stomach and steams upward along the channels, erupting as vesicles at the mucocutaneous junctions around the lips and nostrils. In those with constitutional Yin deficiency and internal Heat, vacuity fire battling with the external pathogen can likewise trigger an outbreak. The pathogen repeatedly lies latent in the skin and channels, flaring again with triggers such as overexertion, emotional constraint, febrile illness, or menstruation, producing a protracted recurrent course; ruptured vesicles that become secondarily infected may develop erosion and exudation.
key_manifestations_zh: 患處皮膚先有灼熱、瘙癢或刺痛感，繼而出現成簇粟粒大小水皰
好發於口唇、鼻孔周圍、面頰或外陰等皮膚黏膜交界處
水皰皰壁薄，易破潰，破後糜爛滲液，結痂而愈
病程約1-2週，有自限性
易在熱病、勞累、情志波動、月經前後等誘因下於同一部位反覆發作
key_manifestations_en: A burning, itching, or stinging sensation at the site precedes a cluster of millet-sized vesicles
Predilection for mucocutaneous junctions such as the lips, perinasal skin, cheeks, or genitalia
Thin-walled vesicles that rupture easily, leaving erosion and exudation before crusting and healing
A self-limited course lasting about 1-2 weeks
Prone to recurring at the same site, triggered by febrile illness, overexertion, emotional fluctuation, or the perimenstrual period
associated_manifestations_zh: 局部淋巴結可腫大壓痛
外陰皰疹可伴排尿疼痛
associated_manifestations_en: Regional lymph nodes may be enlarged and tender
May be accompanied by mild fever and dry mouth
Genital herpes outbreaks may cause painful urination
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在皮膚黏膜，與肺、胃相關，反覆發作者與陰虛內熱體質相關。
records.disease_location_en: The disease location is the skin and mucosa, related to the Lung and Stomach; recurrent cases relate to an underlying Yin-deficient, internal-Heat constitution.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以疏風清熱解毒為主；陰虛內熱者佐以養陰清熱；反覆發作者須兼顧扶正，清解伏熱。
records.treatment_principle_en: The main treatment principle is to disperse Wind, clear Heat, and resolve toxin; those with Yin deficiency and internal Heat additionally require nourishing Yin and clearing Heat; recurrent cases require supporting the correct Qi alongside clearing the latent Heat.
red_flags_zh: 皰疹發生於眼周或眼瞼，伴眼睛紅痛、畏光、視力模糊者，應立即轉診眼科，警惕疱疹性角膜炎，可能導致視力損害，不可僅以外用中藥處理
外陰部位反覆發作水皰潰瘍，應懷疑生殖器單純皰疹（一種性傳染病），建議轉診檢查並排查其他性傳染病
孕婦於接近產期出現生殖器皰疹發作，應立即告知產科醫師以評估分娩方式，避免新生兒皰疹感染風險
免疫力低下患者（如愛滋病、化療中）出現大範圍或非典型皰疹，應立即轉診，警惕全身播散性感染
red_flags_en: Vesicles occurring around the eye or eyelid with redness, pain, photophobia, or blurred vision should be referred to ophthalmology immediately — watch for herpetic keratitis, which can cause vision loss, and do not manage with topical herbal medicine alone
Recurrent vesicular ulcers in the genital area should raise suspicion for genital herpes simplex (a sexually transmitted infection) and warrant referral for testing and screening for other STIs
A pregnant patient nearing term who develops a genital herpes outbreak should be reported to the obstetric provider immediately to evaluate the mode of delivery and prevent neonatal herpes infection
An immunocompromised patient (e.g. HIV/AIDS, undergoing chemotherapy) who develops widespread or atypical herpetic lesions should be referred immediately — watch for disseminated systemic infection

records.definition_zh: 凍瘡是因氣候寒冷，寒邪侵襲肌膚，氣血凝滯不通所致的局部皮膚損傷性疾病，以肢體末端（手指、足趾、耳廓、鼻尖等）皮膚紫紅腫脹、灼癢疼痛，重者潰爛為主要表現，好發於冬季氣溫驟降時，相當於西醫學的凍瘡（chilblain）及凍傷（frostbite）。
records.definition_en: Dong Chuang (Frostbite/Chilblains) is a localized cold-induced skin injury caused by Cold pathogen invading the skin and congealing Qi-Blood flow, presenting as purplish-red swelling with burning, itching, and pain at the extremities (fingers, toes, ear rims, nose tip), progressing to ulceration in severe cases. It is most common during sudden winter temperature drops, and corresponds to Western medicine's chilblains and frostbite.
records.etiology_zh: 素體陽氣虛弱、氣血運行不暢之人，復感嚴寒濕邪，寒邪侵襲肢體末端暴露部位，氣血為寒邪所凝滯；局部保暖不足、潮濕、久居寒冷環境或血液循環障礙者尤易發病。
records.etiology_en: Those with constitutionally weak Yang Qi and sluggish Qi-Blood circulation who are then exposed to severe Cold-Damp are most susceptible: the Cold pathogen invades exposed extremities and congeals the local Qi-Blood. Inadequate warmth, dampness, prolonged exposure to cold environments, or underlying poor circulation further predispose to onset.
records.pathomechanism_zh: 寒為陰邪，其性收引凝滯，寒邪侵襲肌膚，阻遏陽氣，氣血運行不暢，凝滯不通，肌膚失於溫煦濡養，故見局部紫紅腫脹；寒鬱日久可化熱，故患處灼熱瘙癢；氣血瘀阻甚者，肌膚失養，可致潰爛，難以速斂；素體陽虛氣血不足者，復感之後更易發病，且癒後易於復發。
records.pathomechanism_en: Cold is a Yin pathogen whose nature is to contract and congeal; when it invades the skin it obstructs Yang Qi, so Qi-Blood flow becomes sluggish and stagnant, and the skin, deprived of warming and nourishment, shows localized purplish-red swelling. Depressed Cold that lingers can transform into Heat, producing burning and itching at the site. Where Qi-Blood stasis is severe, the malnourished skin can ulcerate and heal slowly. Those with an underlying Yang-deficient, Qi-Blood-insufficient constitution are more susceptible to recurrent episodes after re-exposure to cold.
key_manifestations_zh: 好發於手指、足趾、耳廓、鼻尖、面頰等末梢暴露部位
患處皮膚局限性紫紅色或暗紅色腫脹，邊界不清
遇熱後灼熱、癢痛加劇，遇冷則麻木或脹痛
重者皮膚出現水皰，破潰後形成潰瘍，癒合緩慢
每年寒冷季節反覆發作，氣候轉暖後可自行緩解
key_manifestations_en: Predilection for peripheral exposed sites: fingers, toes, ear rims, nose tip, and cheeks
Localized purplish-red or dusky-red swelling with poorly defined borders
Burning and itching-pain worsen with warming, while numbness or distending pain occur on cold exposure
In severe cases, vesicles form and rupture into slow-healing ulcers
Recurs annually during the cold season and resolves spontaneously as the weather warms
associated_manifestations_zh: 繼發感染時可見紅腫化膿
associated_manifestations_en: Diminished sensation or numbness at the site
Redness, swelling, and suppuration when secondary infection occurs
records.disease_location_zh: 病位在肌膚肢體末端，與陽氣不足、氣血運行不暢相關。
records.disease_location_en: The disease location is the skin of the distal extremities, related to Yang Qi insufficiency and sluggish Qi-Blood circulation.
records.treatment_principle_zh: 以溫經散寒、活血通脈為主要治法；已潰者兼以解毒生肌；平素陽虛氣血不足者宜溫陽益氣養血以治本，並注意防寒保暖以防復發。
records.treatment_principle_en: The main treatment principle is to warm the channels, dispel Cold, invigorate Blood, and unblock the vessels; ulcerated lesions additionally require resolving toxin and promoting granulation. Those with an underlying Yang-deficient, Qi-Blood-insufficient constitution should warm Yang and tonify Qi-Blood to treat the root, with attention to cold protection to prevent recurrence.
red_flags_zh: 患處皮膚顏色轉為蒼白、青紫或黑色，質地變硬如蠟樣，伴局部感覺完全喪失者，提示嚴重凍傷（組織凍結深達皮下組織甚至肌肉骨骼），應立即轉診急診，採取專業緩慢復溫等處置，切勿搓揉患處或直接以火烤、熱敷，以免加重組織損傷
患處出現大水皰、皮膚壞死發黑或伴惡臭分泌物者，提示可能繼發感染或組織壞疽，應立即轉診外科評估，避免僅以中藥外治延誤病情
全身出現寒顫、意識模糊、心律不整等低體溫症徵象者，屬全身性凍傷急症，應立即送醫急救
red_flags_en: Skin that turns pale, blue-purple, or black and becomes hard/waxy in texture, with complete loss of local sensation, indicates severe frostbite (freezing extending to subcutaneous tissue or even muscle and bone) — refer to emergency care immediately for professional slow-rewarming management; never rub the area or apply direct fire or heat, as this can worsen tissue damage

Large blisters, blackened/necrotic skin, or foul-smelling discharge at the site suggest secondary infection or tissue gangrene — refer to surgery immediately rather than relying on topical herbal treatment alone
Systemic shivering, confusion, or cardiac arrhythmia suggest hypothermia, a systemic cold-injury emergency — seek emergency medical care immediately
